verdict.rationale: Convex's own CLI offers bulk data movement: `npx convex import` loads data from a file into a deployment, and `npx convex export` dumps it to a ZIP. That is a first-party bulk capability, but it only covers loading and exporting. Bulk update or delete across many existing documents would have to be hand-written as transactional mutations, which is a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete or batch-mutation primitives, agent/MCP-exposed bulk operations, limits or scale details for import, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: `npx convex import` — Import data from a file to your deployment
npx convex export — Export data from your deployment to a ZIP file
